title: Adsorption of human serum proteins of collagen membranes
projectDescription: The objective of this preliminary study is to characterize the profile of human serum proteins adsorbed on collagen membranes used for guided bone regeneration.
sampleProcessingProtocol: Pooled human serum was loaded on commercial porcine derived collagen membranes for 1 h, followed by thorough washing and drying. Comparison of 2 methods of protein extraction with or without enrichment of low abundance serum proteins.
dataProcessingProtocol: Data search using Proteome Discoverer. Bioinformatics using Perseus and Funrich. DEPs, GO, and functional enrichment analysis.

references.referenceLine: Shanbhag S, Al-Sharabi N, Fritz-Wallace K, Kristoffersen EK, Bunæs DF, Romandini M, Mustafa K, Sanz M, Gruber R. Proteomic Analysis of Human Serum Proteins Adsorbed onto Collagen Barrier Membranes. J Funct Biomater. 2024 15(10):302
